dancing-with-the-stars-live-2027-tour.label: Dancing show
dancing-with-the-stars-live-2027-tour.heading: No setlist. It’s a dance show.
dancing-with-the-stars-live-2027-tour.body: Dancing with the Stars: Live! brings the show’s pros to arenas across North America from January to April 2027, with 60 shows directed by Mandy Moore. Emma Slater co-hosts. Celebrity guests will be announced.
dancing-with-the-stars-live-2027-tour.castNote: Rylee Arnold and Sharna Burgess appear on select dates.
dancing-with-the-stars-live-2027-tour.description: Dancing with the Stars: Live! 2027 tour dates, the pros on tour, and a guide to every arena. 60 shows across North America, January to April 2027.
